title: Static High-Rump Short-Downturned-Proboscis Tapir
description: One complete newly authored stylised tapir-like quadruped in a fixed four-foot stance. A high rounded rump slopes through a deep barrel torso into a narrow lowered head, whose entire upper muzzle continues as one short downward-curved fleshy proboscis with a small blunt tip, not a separate attached tube. Small rounded upright ears with integral pale rims, small side eyes, four complete short strong legs and shallow broad finite feet, plus a tiny low rear tail complete the animal. All actual body sections, head bend and leg/ear outlines are new. Not a pig with its disk stretched, a hornless rhinoceros or a scaled elephant with a cut-off trunk; no old visible meshes imported. One static whole animal model zero scenes. Artistic external resemblance only, no exact species, anatomical digit count, airway/feeding function, gait, live behavior, rig or handling safety claim.
